en: Dependent on a wholesome state with a limited object, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor has a limited object by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are nine under root; nine under predominance … [and so on] … three under mutuality … [and so on] … three under result … [and so on] … nine under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome state with a sublime object, there arises an unwholesome state with a non-sublime object by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine; under predominance condition there are nine ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are nine.

Dependent on a wholesome state with an immeasurable object, there arises an unwholesome state with a non-immeasurable object by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six ... [and so on] ... under resultant condition there are three ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.
